scope: Current Classic UI production build before any Ballpark runtime dependency

repository.note: Measurements include the user's existing uncommitted Game Center, Pitch Replay, Tags, Daily Update and documentation work.

warnings: Node DEP0155 warnings from trailing slash export mappings in Vue/VueUse dependencies

route_loading.method: SSR HTML followed by hashed Nuxt client assets; route CSS and the register route are separate/preloaded resources
route_loading.note: Warm transferSize excludes browser-cached asset bodies.

cold_load_samples.definition: Fresh browser context, 1280x720, wait for load then 750 ms, local loopback, three repetitions

memory.method: performance.memory after a 1 second settle and CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage
memory.interpretation: The first block includes lazy loading/register-route retention. The additional 20 cycles retained 291620 bytes after forced GC. This is a baseline observation, not proof of a leak or listener cleanup.

frame_sample.scope: Static unauthenticated login page; no authenticated Pitch Replay scene was available

authenticated_routes.reason: No approved credentials or existing authenticated session were available.

pitch_replay.reason: The representative scene is behind authentication; no credentials were created or guessed.

real_mobile_device.reason: Only a narrow desktop-browser viewport was tested.

real_low_end_device.reason: No representative low-end hardware was attached; no CPU/network emulation was used.

listener_count.reason: No cross-browser supported listener-count API; route-cycle heap is retained as limited cleanup evidence.

input_latency.reason: Keyboard reachability was executed, but no authenticated representative interaction latency was measured.

future_budgets_not_yet_passed.classic_ui_rule: No Phaser, Babylon, WebGL runtime, or Ballpark asset request on non-Ballpark initial routes.
future_budgets_not_yet_passed.note: These are future release budgets, not A4 measured passes. Re-test on deployed networking and representative low-end hardware.

reproduction: cd frontend && set PORT=3100 && set NUXT_API_INTERNAL_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api && node .output/server/index.mjs
Run Playwright CLI cold-load, compatibility, interaction and memory scripts recorded by the A4 evidence workflow.
